templates.title: TESU business, credit by credit
templates.summary: A 120-credit ledger with a partial published outside-course map is available. Compare standard residency with the conditional Edison Accelerate alternative after your credit source types and remaining business work are clear.
constraints: The current course model uses standard nonmilitary residency.
ACE/NCCRS credit, institutional-origin credit and TESU residency need separate accounting.
Open electives, recommendation dates, provider status and some prerequisites remain unresolved.
The reduced-course fee alternative has conditions and unclear renewal wording.

The ledger lists alternative requirement options, not a selected course basket or awarded credit. Use the plan builder to check a proposed combination; confirm current catalog and individual placement with the university.
steps: Choose catalog and submit original-source learning records.
Reconcile the partial map with the official GE/core/area/elective audit.
Fill upper-level and eligible institutional-origin gaps without duplicates.
Compare standard and fee-based residency using current charges.
Complete approved outside work and TESU courses in prerequisite order.
Resolve open electives, capstone entry and the final audit.

Build semesters from actual residential offerings, housing and aid.
Finish campus work, open selections and official graduation audit.
